full_text: Intro Privacy Policy AWESOME TECHNOLOGIES INC. Respects Your Privacy AWESOME TECHNOLOGIES INC (herein known as “ATI”) and its website www.awesometechinc.com respect your privacy. This Privacy Statement informs you of our privacy practices and of the choices you can make about the way your information is collected online and how that information is used. If you have questions or concerns regarding this statement, you should first contact ATI using the contact information included at the end of this statement. 1. Sites Covered by This Privacy Statement ATI is a global organization with legal entities and multiple websites that cross borders. This Privacy Statement applies to all ATI-owned websites and domains and the websites and domains of our wholly owned subsidiaries (“ATI website”). The ATI website may provide links to third-party websites for your convenience and information. If you access those links, you will leave the ATI website. ATI does not control those sites or their privacy practices, which may differ from ATI’s practices. We do not endorse or make any representations about third-party websites. We encourage you to review the privacy policy of any company before submitting your personal information. 2. Collection of Personal Information ATI collects, exports, and uses personal information with appropriate notice and consent where required. For example, when you: Order products or services Request information Subscribe to marketing or support materials Register products Enter contests or surveys Apply for employment The types of personal information may include: Name, address, phone number, email Financial data such as credit card information User IDs and passwords Billing and transaction details Product preferences Employment and educational background ATI may also collect information automatically through: Cookies Web beacons Embedded web links Information gathering tools This may include browser type, IP address, clickstream behavior, referring pages, and access times. 3. How We Use Your Information ATI uses collected information to: Process transactions Provide support and services Communicate about products and updates Deliver promotional offers Personalize website content Conduct market research Credit card information is used only for payment processing and fraud prevention. 4. How We Share Your Information ATI does not sell, rent, or lease personal information to third parties. We may share personal information with: Service providers (payment processors, shipping agents, email providers) Marketing partners (where you opt in) ATI-owned global entities We may also disclose personal information if required by law, subpoena, court order, or to protect ATI’s rights and safety. 5. Communications and SMS Usage We use SMS solely to send one-time passcodes (OTP) for login authentication and security verification. Messages are transactional, not promotional. Message frequency depends on login activity. Message and data rates may apply. Opt-Out: Reply STOP to opt out of SMS messages at any time. Mobile Opt-In Data Protection Mobile numbers collected for authentication are not sold, rented, or shared for marketing purposes. Service providers used for SMS delivery are contractually prohibited from using mobile data for any other purpose. For SMS-related questions, email: support@awesometechinc.com 6. Children’s Privacy ATI does not knowingly collect information from children under 13 and does not target its website to children under 13. 7. Your Choices and Privacy Preferences You may opt out of marketing communications by: Clicking the “unsubscribe” link in emails Returning to the registration page Contacting the ATI Privacy Office Transactional or service-related communications cannot be opted out of if required for service delivery. 8. Access to and Accuracy of Your Information You may request access to, correction, anonymization, or deletion of your personal information where applicable. Identity verification may be required before granting access. 9. Keeping Your Personal Information Secure ATI uses physical, technical, and administrative safeguards to protect your data. Sensitive data such as credit card information is protected using encryption technologies such as SSL (Secure Socket Layer). Fraud management services are used for additional security during payment processing. 10. Changes to This Statement If this Privacy Statement changes, we will post the revised version on this page with an updated revision date. 11. Contacting Us If you have questions regarding this Privacy Statement, please contact: ATI Privacy Mailbox 4400 State Highway 121 Ste 374 Lewisville, TX 75056 Email: support@awesometechinc.com AWESOME TECHNOLOGIES INC.
